model_annotation: Figure 6 illustrates the training dynamics of LLaMA-On-Policy-Easy and LLaMA-LUFFY-Easy, alongside LLaMA-On-Policy-Hard and LLaMA-LUFFY-Hard. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and spans from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The LLaMA-On-Policy-Easy line is solid black and begins at a value of approximately 0.05 at step 0, gradually increasing to approximately 0.15 at step 500. The LLaMA-LUFFY-Easy line is solid teal and starts at approximately 0.10 at step 0, fluctuating between approximately 0.10 and 0.15 before reaching approximately 0.15 at step 500. The LLaMA-On-Policy-Hard line is dashed red and begins at approximately 0.05 at step 0, showing a gradual increase to approximately 0.10 at step 500. The LLaMA-LUFFY-Hard line is dashed cyan and starts at approximately 0.10 at step 0, fluctuating between approximately 0.10 and 0.15 before reaching approximately 0.15 at step 500.
